Messages.Body:
Hello All,

What all with the questions on Damage Prevention on the newsgroup, some
questions were came up at one of our weekly gaming nights.

1. A Sideslip was played to prevent a strike from a Gangrel's Claw of
the Dead strike. Another player disagreed on the damage prevention of
the aggravated damage. So the question is, what type of damage does
damage prevention cards prevent? (Besides the ones that contain text
stating "Non-aggravated")

2. In a situation where you are receiving both types of damage from
two different sources in a combat (i.e. Carrion Crows at superior and
Lucky Blow with Claws of the Dead) and you are holding 1 Skin of Rock
(playable at superior), do you have the capability to decide which
damage you can prevent?

3. In a situation where you have a Master card or piece of equipment
that prevents damage (i.e. Guardian Angel or Talbot's Chainsaw) and you
receive both types of damage from two different sources, do you have
the capability to decide which damage you can prevent?

4. Carrying over from Question 3 when you possess one of the Master
cards or pieces of equipment that prevents damage, if you are on the
receiving end of multiple strikes in a round of combat can you decide
to hold the damage prevention in the first round with the expectation
of preventing an aggravated strike in a later strike or do you have to
prevent the damage in the first round?

Thanks

Michael Eichler

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Derek S. Ray
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 20 Jan 2000 17:52:05 GMT, ramst...@my-deja.com wrote:

>Hello All,
>
>What all with the questions on Damage Prevention on the newsgroup, some
>questions were came up at one of our weekly gaming nights.
>
>1. A Sideslip was played to prevent a strike from a Gangrel's Claw of
>the Dead strike. Another player disagreed on the damage prevention of
>the aggravated damage. So the question is, what type of damage does
>damage prevention cards prevent? (Besides the ones that contain text
>stating "Non-aggravated")

if it doesn't specify, any damage. the example above would work.

>2. In a situation where you are receiving both types of damage from
>two different sources in a combat (i.e. Carrion Crows at superior and
>Lucky Blow with Claws of the Dead) and you are holding 1 Skin of Rock
>(playable at superior), do you have the capability to decide which
>damage you can prevent?

yes. you can prevent the agg first. (and usually do. =)

>3. In a situation where you have a Master card or piece of equipment
>that prevents damage (i.e. Guardian Angel or Talbot's Chainsaw) and you
>receive both types of damage from two different sources, do you have
>the capability to decide which damage you can prevent?

no difference between talbot's and inferior skin of rock, so yes.
Except that skin of rock is fortitude, and a number of cards state
"can't be prevented by fortitude." =)

>4. Carrying over from Question 3 when you possess one of the Master
>cards or pieces of equipment that prevents damage, if you are on the
>receiving end of multiple strikes in a round of combat can you decide
>to hold the damage prevention in the first round with the expectation
>of preventing an aggravated strike in a later strike or do you have to
>prevent the damage in the first round?

you don't ever HAVE to prevent damage. you can hang on to wait and
look for the agg. =)

-- Derek

It only stopped them hearing the distractions.
